blatant.name: SQL Injection (Standard Union)
blatant.description: Plaintext UNION SELECT attack. Naive regex flags 'union.*select'.

blatant.name: Directory Traversal (Plain Dot-Dot-Slash)
blatant.description: Standard traversal looking for /etc/passwd. Flags on '../' and '/etc/passwd'.

blatant.name: Reflected XSS (Classic Script Tag)
blatant.description: Standard script tag XSS. Flags on '<script.*?>'.

blatant.name: Sensitive File Probing (.env)
blatant.description: Recon probe for environment variable file. Flags on '.env'.

blatant.name: Sensitive File Probing (.git)
blatant.description: Recon probe for git exposure. Flags on '.git'.

blatant.name: Admin Portal Recon (phpMyAdmin)
blatant.description: Recon probe for database management tools. Flags on 'phpmyadmin'.

evasion.name: Directory Traversal (URL Encoded Slashes)
evasion.description: Encodes '/' as '%2f'. Bypasses regex searching for '../' if URL is not decoded first.

evasion.name: Directory Traversal (Double URL Encoding)
evasion.description: Double encodes '%2e' into '%252e'. Defeats single-pass URL decoders.

evasion.name: SQL Injection (Inline SQL Comment Obfuscation)
evasion.description: Uses '/**/' comments instead of spaces. May defeat regexes assuming whitespace.

evasion.name: XSS (SVG Onload - Non-Script Tag)
evasion.description: Uses SVG event handler without '<script>' tag or 'onerror'. Bypasses specific tag filters.

evasion.name: XSS (Body OnPageshow Event)
evasion.description: Alternative event handler payload that completely avoids typical regex rules.

evasion.name: Automated Scanner Fingerprint (User-Agent sqlmap)
evasion.description: Attacker using sqlmap without spoofing User-Agent. Missed if analyzer only checks path.
